sourceInputs.sourceAuditReason: StudyMY audit JSON stays safe_to_import=false by contract; this importer publishes only after Ian's explicit operator command.

writePolicy.universityRow: upsert by code UUM or slug universiti-utara-malaysia-uum
writePolicy.programmeRows: upsert 105 current UUM all-level public rows and archive non-current UUM rows
writePolicy.frontendDesignPolicy: data-only publication; no web component, style or layout edits

publicationPolicy.rationale: UUM undergraduate list IELTS follows Ian's MUET-equivalent display instruction; UUM duration display uses official full-time/minimum duration evidence; UUM public tuition display now uses scalar total tuition only. Undergraduate rows use official HEA total fees; postgraduate rows use UUM official rates calculated against official duration or official credit-hour evidence, with mode-specific fee notes preserved in details.

masterStrictFeeGateStats.primaryFeePolicy: public list/main tuition must be scalar total tuition; postgraduate totals are calculated from official UUM fee rates plus current official programme credit hours or official full-time minimum duration, with mode-specific fees preserved in details

doctoralStrictFeeGateStats.primaryFeePolicy: public list/main tuition must be scalar total tuition; doctoral totals are calculated from official UUM semester rates plus official full-time minimum duration, with coursework/pre-requisite/viva notes preserved in details

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Do not use MUET equivalence table as direct IELTS evidence
qualityRuleCandidates.description: When a university page has programme-specific MUET requirements plus a separate MUET-to-IELTS equivalence table, language.ielts must remain null unless the programme requirement itself directly states IELTS.
qualityRuleCandidates.triggeredBy: UUM HEA English Language Requirements page and SOC generic IELTS wording

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Differentiate academic duration from fee charging semesters
qualityRuleCandidates.description: When official fee PDFs list chargeable semesters and programme pages list academic duration, do not overwrite duration without source-conflict review.
qualityRuleCandidates.triggeredBy: UUM local detail pages vs international fee PDF semester differences

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Ready curriculum must not contain structure labels
qualityRuleCandidates.description: For publicDisplayStatus=ready, curriculum must contain actual Chinese course items or an official-unpublished status; section headings such as core/elective/major/track labels cannot be displayed as courses.
qualityRuleCandidates.triggeredBy: UUM undergraduate reviewed rows UU6210001, UU6224001, UU6222001, UU6222002 and UU6213001

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Direct programme-page IELTS evidence can override equivalence-table caution only when slot evidence is explicit
qualityRuleCandidates.description: If a programme detail page directly states IELTS and TOEFL requirements in an admission language paragraph, IELTS may be written to language.ielts while MUET remains in language.muet; equivalence tables remain excluded.
qualityRuleCandidates.triggeredBy: UUM UU6481001 SOC programme page direct IELTS 5.5 evidence

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Treat fee-table semesters as fee charging evidence, not academic duration
qualityRuleCandidates.description: When a fee PDF lists chargeable semesters and a school/faculty programme page or brochure lists academic duration/semester structure, use the school/faculty academic evidence for duration and keep fee semesters only in tuition notes.
qualityRuleCandidates.triggeredBy: UUM reviewed_v3 duration repairs for SMMTC, SQS, SBM and STHEM programmes

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Programme-page intake months override academic-calendar registration months
qualityRuleCandidates.description: For programme-level intake data, use explicit intake months from the programme page; central academic-calendar registration dates should be recorded as calendar context and not overwrite programme intake.

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Official-unpublished detail fields may pass ready with explicit fieldStatus
qualityRuleCandidates.description: If official programme pages publish programme identity/admission/fee data but no curriculum or career detail after deep crawl, ready rows may keep empty arrays with fieldStatus official-unpublished so public UI displays 官网未公布 rather than invented data.
qualityRuleCandidates.triggeredBy: UUM SAPSP, STML and SCIMPA reviewed_v4 repairs

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: HEA international catalogue is identity source of truth for international undergraduate audit
qualityRuleCandidates.description: When faculty pages contain old/alternate codes but HEA international catalogue and fee PDF agree on code/name, use HEA for programme identity and retain faculty page only as supplementary curriculum source.

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Official flyer SUBJECTS/SPECIALIZATION can be used as public curriculum topics with note
qualityRuleCandidates.description: When an official faculty flyer publishes a SUBJECTS or SPECIALIZATION list but no handbook-level full curriculum, use those items as curriculum topics with curriculumNote and fieldEvidence instead of blocking indefinitely.

qualityRuleCandidates.ruleName: Official scanned or flipbook pages may be used after visual review with explicit evidence note
qualityRuleCandidates.description: When official PDFs or official-page-linked flipbooks are image-based and machine text extraction fails, rendered page visual review can repair curriculum fields if the reviewed pages are recorded; do not claim OCR/text extraction success.
qualityRuleCandidates.triggeredBy: UUM SoIS scanned academic handbooks and SOL official FlipHTML5 LL.B handbook

undergraduate.repairPolicy: No invented curriculum values. Official flyer SUBJECTS, scanned PDF visual review and official FlipHTML5 page images were used only when tied to official university pages; unknown public fields remain official-unpublished.

round2RepairSummary.remainingNeedsReviewReason: official source conflicts, official unpublished fields, incomplete curriculum evidence, OCR/source-authority blockers or Ian decision required

round3RepairSummary.remainingNeedsReviewReason: official unpublished fields, incomplete curriculum evidence, OCR/FlipHTML5 blockers, programme identity/source conflict, or curriculum category-only evidence

round5RepairSummary.note: All 38 undergraduate programmes are publicDisplayStatus=ready. Remaining pending issues are global quality/source caveats and do not represent programme-level needs-review rows.

undergraduate.durationRepairPolicy: Official-only duration repair. Direct year values are adopted from official programme guide pages; official semester counts are normalized to years for StudyMY list display.

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: 课程中文字段出现“相关专题”等机器占位翻译，形式上是中文但不具备公开展示质量。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: UUM master audit validation found placeholder strings in 38 programme curriculum arrays.
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: V56 应增加占位词扫描：相关专题、翻译待补充、localization pending、纯英文课程项、异常括号残片均不得 ready。

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: UUM Project Paper 标题、课程代码与总学分存在口径冲突时，费用不能按单一 credit-hour 公式计算。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: Rows 47/48/50 show Project Paper (6 credit hours) but BPMZ69912 Research Paper and 42 total credits.
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: V55 应阻断 project/research paper 学分冲突导致的 tuitionMYR 自动计算。

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: 官方硕士多模式/研究型项目无法压成单一全程学费，但用户业务规则允许详情页展示不同模式费率说明。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: Ian confirmed policy in Codex thread on 2026-06-28.
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: Validator 应区分 “commercial ready with single tuitionMYR” 与 “ready with official fee-rate note”，不要把非单一官方费率一律判为采集失败。
qualityRuleCandidates.affectedSkillReference: study-audit-validator V55 / StudyMY public detail fee display

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: 中文列表学院字段含英文缩写或英文学院名，虽然不是完整英文句子但仍违反学院只显示中文规则。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: UUM master reviewed_v2 contained facultyZh = UUM 商学院研究生事务部.
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: V54/V59-V62 应将 facultyZh 中的英文缩写和英文机构名视为中文列表学院泄漏，除非 Ian 明确允许品牌缩写。
qualityRuleCandidates.affectedSkillReference: study-audit-validator V54 / V59-V62 multilingual interface isolation

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: 多模式专业课程应以中文扁平数组保留所有官方可见课程项，不把 Mode/Core/Elective 等源站结构写入 public 字段。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: UUM master reviewed_v4 repaired remaining 25 curriculum rows from official Programme Structure pages.
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: collector 和 validator 均应在课程字段输出前扫描源站分组标签与占位词。

policyDecisions.decision: Ian 业务规则确认：多模式专业可在详情页标注不同模式与费用口径，不再因存在多个模式自动阻断；费用/课程页面内部口径冲突时，以最新官方专业介绍页明示文字和年份为优先。
policyDecisions.application: Resolved tuition/studyMode pending blockers; curriculum pending remains separate.

policyDecisions.decision: 专业列表中专业名称需要中英文双语；学院只显示中文，不显示英文学院名或中英双语学院名。
policyDecisions.application: facultyZh must be Chinese-only for zh-CN/zh-TW list display; faculty remains official English for en/ms display.

strictFeeGateStats.primaryFeePolicy: public list/main tuition must be scalar total tuition; postgraduate totals are calculated from official UUM fee rates plus current official programme credit hours or official full-time minimum duration, with mode-specific fees preserved in details

master.durationRepairPolicy: UUM Postgraduate Academic Handbook 2026 section 10 is the duration authority. StudyMY list uses the official full-time minimum numeric duration; mode/range notes remain in details.

strictFeeGateStats.primaryFeePolicy: public list/main tuition must be scalar total tuition; doctoral totals are calculated from official UUM semester rates plus official full-time minimum duration, with coursework/pre-requisite/viva notes preserved in details

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: 博士专业页含国际申请信号，但官方费用表标注 Malaysian only 或无 Non-Malaysian fee row。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: UUM Doctor of Management page/OYAGSB page has general international application signals; 2026 handbook fee table says Doctor of Management (Full-time & Malaysian only).
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: Doctoral fee gate 应阻断把本地费用、普通 PhD 费率或其他博士类别费率套用到该专业国际学生费用；必须 needs-review 等待 Ian/学校确认。

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: 官方年度 handbook 与旧专业页面课程结构不一致时，需优先采用最新年度 handbook 或最新专业介绍页。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: UUM DBA central page contains older course list, while 2026 handbook updates DBA to Business Fields 18 credits + Research Method 15 credits + Dissertation 49 credits.
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: Phase 3 应记录 sourcePriorityPolicy，并把非采纳旧结构写入 fieldEvidence 或 remarks，避免旧页面覆盖年度手册。

qualityRuleCandidates.issuePattern: 官方博士项目费用表明确 Malaysian only 时，应排除出国际学生公开 baseline，而不是保留为缺失费用 needs-review。
qualityRuleCandidates.evidence: UUM Doctor of Management: UUM Postgraduate Fees and 2026 Postgraduate Academic Handbook both label the fee row as Full-time & Malaysian only.
qualityRuleCandidates.proposedGate: collector/reviewer 应支持 not-available-international exclusion decision，并在 sourceRegistry.excludedProgrammeRows 保留证据。

policyDecisions.scope: UUM Doctor of Management international eligibility
policyDecisions.application: Excluded from international doctoral programmes; no longer counted as needs-review.

doctoral.durationRepairPolicy: UUM Postgraduate Academic Handbook 2026 section 10.4 is the duration authority for doctoral mixed-mode/research rows. Ed.D retains its official page rule; details preserve source notes.

undergraduate.suggestedAction: 该模式已命中 skill 的语言成绩不得串字段门禁；后续验收继续检查 IELTS 必须为 null。

evidence.value: Programme table gives MUET Band; equivalence table lists IELTS values separately.

undergraduate.suggestedAction: 保留为官方页面外链证据；验收时可确认是否接受 Google Drive 托管的 HEA 外链。
